high_level_description: This image is a political map of the United States that displays the results of an election. The map is divided into states, each colored either blue or red to indicate which candidate won in that state. The blue states represent the candidate with 226 electoral votes, while the red states represent the candidate with 312 electoral votes. At the top of the image, there is a headline that reads "Donald Trump wins" with a checkmark next to it, indicating that the Associated Press (AP) has called this race for Donald Trump.
